thread_summary: kernel selector roll caused p99 tail bump; investigations involve Nsight + nvprof traces, custom timers for batch_schedule/kv_prefetch/allreduce_wait; hypothesis: combined effect of fused-attn kernel shape + increased KV prefetch and allocator non-determinism leading to rank skew and allreduce tails.
